WITH year_total AS (
    SELECT 
        c_customer_id customer_id,
        d_year dyear,
        SUM(ss_ext_list_price - ss_ext_discount_amt) year_total,
        's' sale_type
    FROM 
        customer
    JOIN 
        store_sales ON c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk
    JOIN 
        date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE 
        d_year IN (1998, 1999)
    GROUP BY 
        c_customer_id, d_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        c_customer_id customer_id,
        d_year dyear,
        SUM(ws_ext_list_price - ws_ext_discount_amt) year_total,
        'w' sale_type
    FROM 
        customer
    JOIN 
        web_sales ON c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk
    JOIN 
        date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE 
        d_year IN (1998, 1999)
    GROUP BY 
        c_customer_id, d_year
),
year_total_filtered AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        dyear,
        year_total,
        sale_type,
        COALESCE(year_total / LAG(year_total) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY dyear), 0.0) AS ratio
    FROM 
        year_total
)
SELECT 
    t_s_secyear.customer_id,
    t_s_secyear.customer_first_name,
    t_s_secyear.customer_last_name,
    t_s_secyear.customer_email_address
FROM (
    SELECT 
        t_s_firstyear.customer_id,
        t_s_firstyear.customer_first_name,
        t_s_firstyear.customer_last_name,
        t_s_firstyear.customer_email_address,
        t_w_secyear.year_total AS ratio_secyear,
        t_s_secyear.year_total AS ratio_firstyear
    FROM 
        year_total_filtered t_s_firstyear
    JOIN 
        year_total_filtered t_s_secyear ON t_s_secyear.customer_id = t_s_firstyear.customer_id AND t_s_secyear.dyear = t_s_firstyear.dyear + 1
    JOIN 
        year_total_filtered t_w_firstyear ON t_w_firstyear.customer_id = t_s_firstyear.customer_id AND t_w_firstyear.dyear = t_s_firstyear.dyear
    JOIN 
        year_total_filtered t_w_secyear ON t_w_secyear.customer_id = t_s_firstyear.customer_id AND t_w_secyear.dyear = t_s_firstyear.dyear + 1
    WHERE 
        t_s_firstyear.sale_type = 's' AND t_w_firstyear.sale_type = 'w' AND t_s_secyear.sale_type = 's' AND t_w_secyear.sale_type = 'w'
) ranked_customers
WHERE 
    ratio_secyear > 0 AND ratio_firstyear > 0
ORDER BY 
    customer_id, customer_first_name, customer_last_name, customer_email_address
LIMIT 100
